description:
The process starts with defining the objectives of a marketing campaign, including the target audience and goals such as generating leads or increasing brand awareness.
The marketing team creates the content, designs the visuals, and selects channels for promotion, whether digital ads, emails, or social media posts.
The campaign is launched, and its performance is tracked in real-time through various metrics like click-through rates and conversions.
Leads generated from the campaign are collected in the CRM system, where sales teams can follow up.
The process concludes when the campaign period ends, and performance is analyzed for future optimization.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_MarketingCampaign"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/marketing-campaign">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MarketingCampaign" name="Marketing campaign" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Campaign" name="Start campaign planning">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_DefineObjectives</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DefineObjectives" name="Define campaign objectives">
      <bpmn:documentation>Define the target audience and campaign goals, such as generating leads or increasing brand awareness.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_DefineObjectives</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Objectives_PreparationSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare campaign">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Objectives_PreparationSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PreparationSplit_Content</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PreparationSplit_Visuals</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PreparationSplit_Channels</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateContent" name="Marketing team: Create campaign content">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PreparationSplit_Content</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Content_PreparationJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DesignVisuals" name="Marketing team: Design campaign visuals">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PreparationSplit_Visuals</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Visuals_PreparationJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectChannels" name="Marketing team: Select promotional channels">
      <bpmn:documentation>Select channels such as digital ads, emails, or social media posts.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PreparationSplit_Channels</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Channels_PreparationJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Campaign preparation complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Content_PreparationJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Visuals_PreparationJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Channels_PreparationJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PreparationJoin_Launch</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_LaunchCampaign" name="Launch campaign">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PreparationJoin_Launch</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Launch_CampaignSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CampaignSplit" name="Run campaign activities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Launch_CampaignSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CampaignSplit_Track</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CampaignSplit_Collect</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CampaignSplit_PeriodEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TrackPerformance" name="Track campaign performance in real time">
      <bpmn:documentation>Track campaign metrics such as click-through rates and conversions.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CampaignSplit_Track</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Track_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Tracking"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectLeads" name="Collect generated leads in CRM">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CampaignSplit_Collect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Collect_FollowUp</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_FollowUpLeads" name="Sales team: Follow up on leads">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Collect_FollowUp</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FollowUp_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_LeadFollowUp"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CampaignPeriodEnds" name="Campaign period ends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CampaignSplit_PeriodEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PeriodEnd_Analyze</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_CampaignPeriodEnds"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnalyzePerformance" name="Analyze campaign performance">
      <bpmn:documentation>Analyze campaign performance for future optimization.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PeriodEnd_Analyze</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Analyze_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CampaignAnalyzed" name="Campaign performance analyzed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Analyze_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_DefineObjectives" sourceRef="StartEvent_Campaign" targetRef="Task_DefineObjectives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Objectives_PreparationSplit" sourceRef="Task_DefineObjectives" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationSplit_Content" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_CreateContent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationSplit_Visuals" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_DesignVisuals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationSplit_Channels" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_SelectChannels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Content_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Task_CreateContent" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visuals_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Task_DesignVisuals" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Channels_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Task_SelectChannels" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationJoin_Launch" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_LaunchCampaign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Launch_CampaignSplit" sourceRef="Task_LaunchCampaign" targetRef="Gateway_CampaignSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CampaignSplit_Track" sourceRef="Gateway_CampaignSplit" targetRef="Task_TrackPerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Track_End" sourceRef="Task_TrackPerformance" targetRef="EndEvent_Tracking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CampaignSplit_Collect" sourceRef="Gateway_CampaignSplit" targetRef="Task_CollectLeads"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_FollowUp" sourceRef="Task_CollectLeads" targetRef="Task_FollowUpLeads"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FollowUp_End" sourceRef="Task_FollowUpLeads" targetRef="EndEvent_LeadFollowUp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CampaignSplit_PeriodEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_CampaignSplit" targetRef="Event_CampaignPeriodEnds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PeriodEnd_Analyze" sourceRef="Event_CampaignPeriodEnds" targetRef="Task_AnalyzePerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Analyze_End" sourceRef="Task_AnalyzePerformance" targetRef="EndEvent_CampaignAnalyzed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
